lines: Mallika R Iyer, Promoter Group, holds shares worth ₹166.90 crore (estimate, valued at offer price); shares, not cash.
Their pre-Offer capital unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, so the trigger is not fresh.
Holdings agree across promoter_holding and shareholding_pattern, though the seller table does not list them.
They hold 1,234,500 shares before the offer and are not selling in it; proceeds and gain are not applicable.
